acceptance: Interpret semantic parameter contract as the sha256 identity of one canonical RelationContract object and semantic parameter statement as the sha256 identity of the exact statement payload named by that contract.
Resolve the RelationContract's pure relation-decision entrypoint and apply it to that exact statement payload and the witness source explicitly declared by the RelationContract binding.

An absent contract, statement payload, binding, witness source, or predicate implementation is unsupported. Otherwise accept exactly when the resolved relation-decision entrypoint returns true; a false result rejects the proof.
The predicate performs no transcript, proof-stream, sponge, route, or ambient protocol effects. Relation-payload conformance and implementation conformance are separate assurance facets.

Resolve parameter suite to one exact tuple (Fr,G1,G2,e,g1,g2,tau_g2,decoders) with additive prime-order groups G1 and G2, nondegenerate bilinear pairing e:G1 x G2 -> GT, generators g1 and g2, and tau_g2 equal to tau times g2 in the pinned SRS. An unknown or ambiguous suite is unsupported.
Decode commitment C and proof W in G1 and point z and value y in Fr using the resolved suite. A decode failure rejects the proof.
Accept exactly when e(C - y*g1, g2) equals e(W, tau_g2 - z*g2).
The predicate performs no transcript, proof-stream, sponge, route, or ambient protocol effects. Concrete decoder and pairing conformance are separate assurance facets.
Resolve parameter suite exactly as in the KZG single-point opening predicate. An unknown or ambiguous suite is unsupported.

Let n be the common operand multiplicity, with n at least 2. Decode commitments C_0 through C_(n-1) and proof W in G1 and point z, values y_0 through y_(n-1), and batch_challenge gamma in Fr. A decode failure rejects the proof.
Compute C_star as the sum from i=0 to n-1 of gamma^i*C_i and y_star as the sum from i=0 to n-1 of gamma^i*y_i. Commitment and value positions are paired by the same index.
Accept exactly when e(C_star - y_star*g1, g2) equals e(W, tau_g2 - z*g2).

The predicate performs no transcript, proof-stream, sponge, route, or ambient protocol effects. Sampling and binding gamma to every ordered member are obligations of the enclosing protocol; concrete decoder and pairing conformance are separate assurance facets.
